question: rank boroughs by pickup count
sql: SELECT z.borough, COUNT(*) AS pickups, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS pickup_rank FROM nyc_taxi_trips t JOIN nyc_taxi_zones z ON t.PULocationID = z.location_id GROUP BY z.borough ORDER BY pickup_rank, z.borough;

question: busiest pickup zone in each borough
sql: WITH zone_counts AS (SELECT z.borough, z.zone, COUNT(*) AS pickups FROM nyc_taxi_trips t JOIN nyc_taxi_zones z ON t.PULocationID = z.location_id GROUP BY z.borough, z.zone), ranked AS (SELECT borough, zone, pickups, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY borough ORDER BY pickups DESC, zone) AS rn FROM zone_counts) SELECT borough, zone, pickups FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY borough;

question: manhattan daily pickups jan 2024 with running total
sql: WITH daily AS (SELECT CAST(t.tpep_pickup_datetime AS DATE) AS day, COUNT(*) AS pickups FROM nyc_taxi_trips t JOIN nyc_taxi_zones z ON t.PULocationID = z.location_id WHERE z.borough = 'Manhattan' AND t.tpep_pickup_datetime >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01' AND t.tpep_pickup_datetime < TIMESTAMP '2024-02-01' GROUP BY day) SELECT day, pickups, SUM(pickups) OVER (ORDER BY day) AS running_total FROM daily ORDER BY day;

question: top 5 taxi zones by area km2
sql: WITH areas AS (SELECT zone, borough, ST_Area_Spheroid(geometry) / 1000000.0 AS area_km2 FROM nyc_taxi_zones) SELECT zone, borough, ROUND(area_km2, 2) AS area_km2, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY area_km2 DESC, zone) AS area_rank FROM areas ORDER BY area_rank LIMIT 5;

question: 5 taxi zones nearest to point (-73.9700, 40.7500) with distance in km
sql: WITH dist AS (SELECT zone, borough, ST_Distance_Sphere(ST_Point(-73.9700, 40.7500), ST_Centroid(geometry)) / 1000.0 AS dist_km FROM nyc_taxi_zones) SELECT zone, borough, ROUND(dist_km, 3) AS dist_km, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY dist_km, zone) AS rn FROM dist ORDER BY rn LIMIT 5;

question: top 10 manhattan pickup zones with cumulative share of borough pickups
sql: WITH zc AS (SELECT z.zone, COUNT(*) AS pickups FROM nyc_taxi_trips t JOIN nyc_taxi_zones z ON t.PULocationID = z.location_id WHERE z.borough = 'Manhattan' GROUP BY z.zone) SELECT zone, pickups, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY pickups DESC, zone) AS rn, ROUND(SUM(pickups) OVER (ORDER BY pickups DESC, zone) * 1.0 / SUM(pickups) OVER (), 4) AS cum_share FROM zc ORDER BY rn LIMIT 10;
